VisionDemand.description:
Why Vision wants camera frames; decides which limits apply without a present viewer
(owner decision 2026-10-18).
VisionDemand.title: VisionDemand

description:
Request on ``gateway.mower.<id>.photo``: a still image of the mower's surroundings.

``account_id`` must be the mower's account; the gateway refuses other accounts with
``not_found`` so a foreign mower never reveals itself.

demand.description: Why the photo is wanted: `error_analysis` (a mower with a problem: AI assist, the automatic analysis) may wake a sleeping mower through the camera relay and ignores the Vision budget; `routine` keeps every limit (ADR 0045).

max_frames.description: Up to this many frames of the same moment, one per camera (2: both front cameras as a stereo pair); `max_bytes` caps them together. 1: the single `image_base64`.
max_frames.title: Max Frames

title: PhotoRequest
